videos.description:
Light-sheet fluorescence recording of the TH-GFP preparation used in the AeroSense project. This recording visualizes GFP-labelled anatomy; the associated quantitative analysis and acquisition context are described on our team wiki. Playback runs at 6 frames per second and is distinct from acquisition time. This video contains no narration or music.

videos.description: Trypsin–benzamidine positive-control pilot for the guided ligand-displacement workflow. Saved atomic positions show a nominal 0.20 nm/ns pulling target followed by force-free release. At 11.200 ns the original binding pose is lost (zero native atom-pair contacts); contact with the protein remains. This illustrates displacement under applied force and does not measure spontaneous dissociation kinetics or odorant-receptor activation. English on-screen annotations; no audio. Team wiki: https://2026.igem.wiki/nthu/
